mapper.sql: a.id, a.application_type, a.member_id, a.book_id, a.borrow_record_id, a.borrowing_policy_id, a.borrowing_policy_version, a.requested_days, a.reason, a.status, a.submitted_at, a.expires_at, a.processed_at, a.processed_by, a.approved_copy_id, a.approved_days, a.decision_remark, a.version, a.created_at, a.updated_at
mapper.insert: insert into borrow_application(application_type, member_id, book_id, borrow_record_id, borrowing_policy_id, borrowing_policy_version, requested_days, reason, status, submitted_at, expires_at, version) values(#{applicationType}, #{memberId}, #{bookId}, #{borrowRecordId}, #{borrowingPolicyId}, #{borrowingPolicyVersion}, #{requestedDays}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{submittedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{version})
mapper.select: select from borrow_application a where a.status = 'PENDING' and a.expires_at > #{now} order by a.id
mapper.update: update borrow_application set status = 'APPROVED', processed_at = #{now}, processed_by = #{processor}, approved_copy_id = #{copyId}, approved_days = #{days}, decision_remark = #{remark}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING' and version = #{version}
